User.title: User
User.description: Core user profile storing credentials, role, UK senior/carer details, and accessibility preferences.

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user in plain English.

email.description: Email address for login and notifications.

phone.description: UK telephone or mobile number for SMS/call verifications.

plan.description: Subscription or service tier (e.g. free, standard, family_plus).

accessibilitySettings.description: Senior-friendly accessibility configuration including font size, contrast, and voice synthesis.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or server timestamp when the user profile was created.

FamilyLink.title: FamilyLink
FamilyLink.description: Delegated trust and permission linkage connecting a Senior with a Family Carer or Guardian.

linkId.description: Unique identifier for the family link relationship.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen granting or holding care access.

familyUid.description: UID of the family member or carer receiving access.

permissions.description: Map of module identifiers to permission levels (view, edit, manage).

status.description: Current status of the family link.

invitedBy.description: UID of the party that initiated the care invitation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation or linkage was created.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: In-app alerts, scam safety warnings, reminder chimes, and carer updates.

type.description: Notification category (e.g. scam_alert, reminder, carer_invite, document_shared).

payload.description: Structured payload details including title, body, and navigation route.

read.description: Whether the notification has been acknowledged or read.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was dispatched.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable security and permission audit log entry written by system triggers and Cloud Functions.

actorUid.description: UID of the user or system agent executing the action.

action.description: Action executed (e.g. PERMISSION_CHANGE, LINK_REVOKED, LOGIN, SCAM_VERIFIED).

targetUid.description: UID of the target user affected by this action.

targetResource.description: Target resource or collection path modified.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the audit log occurred.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrative record in the secure adminUsers collection used for server-side rule lookups.

ScamCheck.title: ScamCheck
ScamCheck.description: Scam analysis check verifying message security with plain-English verdict, explanation, and UK red flags.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen who submitted the message.

rawContentRef.description: Temporary reference identifier if stored during check, nulled out afterwards for GDPR data-minimisation.

explanation.description: Senior-friendly explanation in clear British English.

redFlags.description: List of specific warning indicators detected.

advice.description: Immediate protective steps for the senior.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the scam check was conducted.

Guide.title: Guide
Guide.description: Pre-written digital step-by-step guidance manuals in plain English.

title.description: Title of the guide (e.g. 'How to make a video call with grandchildren').

steps.description: Numbered step list with clear titles and plain English instructions.

createdBy.description: UID or admin identifier that published this guide.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent update.

Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: Senior life reminders including appointments, renewals, birthdays, and services.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen this reminder belongs to.

title.description: Short, clear title of the reminder in plain English.

dueDate.description: Date or datetime string when the reminder is due (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBy.description: UID of the creator (senior or linked carer).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the reminder was created.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Digitised important household, identity, medical, and financial documents with expiry tracking and family sharing.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen owning this document.

storagePath.description: Cloud storage path pointer scoped to the seniorUid.

sharedWith.description: Array of linked family member UIDs granted view access.

uploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the document was uploaded.

HomeAsset.title: HomeAsset
HomeAsset.description: Registered home appliance, boiler, smoke/CO alarm, or household system with service dates, warranties, and maintenance tracking.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen owning the home asset.

name.description: Name and model of the household asset (e.g. Worcester Bosch Greenstar 8000).

lastServiceDate.description: Date of the most recent service, inspection, or filter change (YYYY-MM-DD).

serviceIntervalMonths.description: Recommended recurring maintenance cycle in months (e.g. 12 for annual boiler check).

notes.description: Useful notes, model numbers, installer names, Gas Safe registration numbers, or location in home.

photoStoragePath.description: Cloud Storage path to the uploaded photo or serial number plate.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the asset record was registered.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the latest edit.

Tradesperson.title: Tradesperson
Tradesperson.description: Trusted UK tradesperson, Gas Safe engineer, electrician, or handyman contact scoped to the senior.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen this trusted contact belongs to.

name.description: Name of tradesperson or company (e.g. Andy Miller Heating & Plumbing).

trade.description: Speciality or trade (e.g. Gas Safe Heating, Electrician, Plumber, Handyman, Locksmith).

phone.description: UK contact telephone or mobile number.

notes.description: Helpful notes, certifications, emergency availability, or trusted family recommendation notes.

isEmergency.description: Whether this contact provides 24/7 or priority emergency callouts (e.g. burst pipes, power outage).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this contact was added.

TrackedSubscription.title: TrackedSubscription
TrackedSubscription.description: User's external recurring subscriptions, memberships, charity direct debits, streaming services, and insurance add-ons.

seniorUid.description: UID of the senior citizen owning this subscription.

provider.description: Name of service provider or company (e.g. Netflix, British Gas, Saga Magazine, PureGym).

category.description: Category classification of subscription (e.g. Streaming & TV, Utilities & Home, Insurance & Protection, Magazines & News, Fitness & Leisure, Charity Direct Debit, Other).

amount.description: Recurring cost per billing cycle in GBP or local currency.

nextRenewalDate.description: Next scheduled payment or auto-renewal date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sharedWithFamily.description: Array of linked family member UIDs with visibility into this subscription.

previousAmount.description: Previous recurring cost before a detected price increase.

flagReason.description: Explanation why this subscription is flagged (e.g. price increase, unexpected renewal).

notes.description: Helpful notes, account or policy number, or cancellation terms.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the subscription was added.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: Public subscription tiers and pricing definitions (Essentials, Complete, Complete + Family).

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscription plan tier.

tagline.description: Short plain-English summary of target audience.

isPopular.description: Whether this plan is highlighted as Most Popular.

modulesIncluded.description: List of module IDs included in this plan.

supportLevel.description: Level of customer and safeguarding support included.

/familyLinks/{linkId}.description: Top-level collection of senior-carer permission linkages.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Top-level immutable collection of audit logs.

/adminUsers/{uid}.description: Top-level collection defining administrative roles for security rule lookups.

/scamChecks/{checkId}.description: Top-level collection of scam detection records.

/guides/{guideId}.description: Top-level collection of digital help step-by-step guides.

/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Top-level collection of life reminders (appointments, renewals, birthdays, services).

/documents/{docId}.description: Top-level collection of secured household, identity, and insurance documents with per-family sharing.

/homeAssets/{assetId}.description: Top-level collection of registered home appliances, boilers, and alarms with maintenance tracking.

/tradespeople/{tradespersonId}.description: Top-level collection of trusted UK tradespeople and emergency home contacts scoped to the senior.

/trackedSubscriptions/{trackId}.description: Top-level collection of user's external tracked subscriptions with renewal alerts, price jump detection, and family summary sharing.

/plans/{planId}.description: Top-level collection of public pricing plans and subscription tiers.
